border.description: Set to true to use borders.

rounded.description: Use rounded borders when border is true.

highlight.description: Background highlight group of float window.

borderhighlight.description: Border highlight group of float window.

close.description: Set to true to draw a close icon.

maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the float window, including the border.

maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the float window, including the border.

focusable.description: Enable focusing by user actions (wincmds, mouse events); Neovim only.

shadow.description: Enable a drop shadow by blending with the background; Neovim only.

winblend.description: Enable pseudo-transparency by setting the 'winblend' option of the window; Neovim only.

position.description: Controls how floating windows are positioned. When set to `'fixed'`, the window will be positioned according to the `top`, `bottom`, `left`, and `right` settings. When set to `'auto'`, the window follows the default position.

top.description: Distance from the top of the editor window in characters. Only takes effect when `position` is set to `'fixed'`. and is ignored if `bottom` is set.

bottom.description: Distance from the bottom of the editor window in characters. Only takes effect when `position` is set to `'fixed'`. Takes precedence over `top` if both are set.

left.description: Distance from the left edge of the editor window in characters. Only takes effect when `position` is set to `'fixed'`. and is ignored if `right` is set.

right.description: Distance from the right edge of the editor window in characters. Only takes effect when `position` is set to `'fixed'`. Takes precedence over `left` if both are set.

languageserver.enable.description: Enable the language server. A coc.nvim restart is required after changing this.

languageserver.filetypes.description: Supported filetypes; add `*` to the array for all filetypes.

languageserver.maxRestartCount.description: Maximum number of restarts when the server closes within the last 3 minutes.

languageserver.cwd.description: Working directory of the language server; an absolute path or relative to the workspace folder. Uses the workspace root by default.

languageserver.initializationOptions.description: Initialization options passed to the language server.

languageserver.stdioEncoding.description: Encoding used for the stdio of the child process.

languageserver.rootPatterns.description: Root patterns used to resolve the rootPath from the current file; defaults to the workspace root.

languageserver.requireRootPattern.description: If true, the server isn't started when no root pattern is found.

languageserver.ignoredRootPaths.description: Absolute root paths that the language server should not use as rootPath; takes priority over rootPatterns.

languageserver.additionalSchemes.description: Additional URI schemes; default schemes include file and untitled.

languageserver.revealOutputChannelOn.description: Configure the message level at which the output channel buffer is shown.

languageserver.progressOnInitialization.description: Enable progress reporting during language server initialization.

languageserver.trace.server.description: Trace level of the communication between server and client.

languageserver.trace.server.verbosity.description: Trace level of the communication between server and client.

languageserver.disableDynamicRegister.description: Disable the dynamic registerCapability feature for this language server to avoid duplicate feature registration.

languageserver.disableSnippetCompletion.description: Disable the snippet completion feature for this language server; the language server may not respect it.

languageserver.disabledFeatures.description: Features disabled for this language server.

languageserver.formatterPriority.description: Priority of this language server's formatter.

port.description: Port number of the socket server.

module.description: Absolute path of the JavaScript file; works in IPC mode.

runtime.description: Absolute path of the node runtime.

execArgv.description: ARGV passed to node when using the module, normally used for debugging. Example: `["--nolazy", "--inspect-brk=6045"]`.

transport.description: Transport kind used by the server; can be 'ipc', 'stdio', 'socket', or 'pipe'.

transportPort.description: Port number used when the transport is 'socket'.

command.description: Executable in $PATH used to start the language server; should not be used with `module`.

shell.description: If true, runs the command inside a shell; always true on Windows.

callHierarchy.enableTooltip.description: Enable tooltip to show relative filepath of call hierarchy.

callHierarchy.openCommand.description: Open command for callHierarchy tree view.

callHierarchy.splitCommand.description: Window split command used by callHierarchy tree view.

coc.preferences.rootPatterns.description: Root patterns used to resolve the workspaceFolder from the parent folders of opened files, resolved from the top down.

coc.preferences.bracketEnterImprove.description: Improve pressing enter inside brackets `<> {} [] ()` by adding a new empty line below and placing the cursor on it. Works with `coc#on_enter()`.

coc.preferences.currentFunctionSymbolAut.description: Automatically update the value of b:coc_current_function on the CursorMove event.

coc.preferences.currentFunctionSymbolDeb.description: Set the debounce timer for the update of b:coc_current_function on the CursorMove event.

coc.preferences.enableMarkdown.description: Tell the language server that markdown text format is supported; note that markdown text may not be rendered as expected.

coc.preferences.enableMessageDialog.description: Enable interactive messages in notification dialogs, or fall back to Vim's native confirm action.

coc.preferences.messageDialogKind.description: Method to use when showing interactive messages to the user

coc.preferences.messageReportKind.description: Method to use when printing or showing plain user messages

coc.preferences.excludeImageLinksInMarkd.description: Exclude image links from markdown text in float windows.

coc.preferences.enableGFMBreaksInMarkdow.description: Enable GFM breaks in markdown documents.

coc.preferences.extensionUpdateCheck.description: Interval for checking extension updates; can be daily, weekly, or never.

coc.preferences.extensionUpdateUIInTab.description: Display the extension update UI in a new Vim tab.

coc.preferences.silentAutoupdate.description: Don't open a split window with update status when performing auto updates.

coc.preferences.floatActions.description: Set to false to disable float/popup support for the actions menu.

coc.preferences.autoApplySingleQuickfix.description: Automatically apply the single quickfix action.

coc.preferences.formatOnSave.description: Set to true to enable formatting on save.

coc.preferences.formatOnSaveTimeout.description: How long before the format command run on save times out.

coc.preferences.formatOnSaveFiletypes.description: Filetypes that should run format on save.
coc.preferences.formatOnSaveFiletypes.deprecationMessage: Use 'coc.preferences.formatOnSave' as language override configuration instead, see :h coc-configuration-scope

coc.preferences.formatOnType.description: Set to true to enable formatting on typing.

coc.preferences.formatOnTypeFiletypes.description: Filetypes that should run format on typing; only works when `coc.preferences.formatOnType` is `true`.
coc.preferences.formatOnTypeFiletypes.deprecationMessage: Use 'coc.preferences.formatOnType' as language override configuration instead, see :h coc-configuration-scope

coc.preferences.formatterExtension.description: Extension used for formatting documents. When set to null, the formatter with highest priority is used.

coc.preferences.jumpCommand.description: Command used for location jumps, like goto definition and goto references. Can also be a custom command that takes a file as an argument.

coc.preferences.maxFileSize.description: Maximum file size in bytes that coc.nvim should handle. Default: '10MB'.

coc.preferences.messageLevel.description: Message level for filtering echoed messages; can be 'more', 'warning', or 'error'.

coc.preferences.promptInput.description: Use a prompt buffer in a float window for user input.

coc.preferences.renameFillCurrent.description: Set to false to stop the Refactor-Rename float/popup window from populating the New Name field with the old name.

coc.preferences.useQuickfixForLocations.description: Use Vim's quickfix list for jump locations; a restart is required when changed.

coc.preferences.watchmanPath.description: Executable path for https://facebook.github.io/watchman/; detected from $PATH by default.

coc.preferences.tagDefinitionTimeout.description: Timeout of CocTagFunc; defaults to infinity.

coc.source.buffer.ignoreGitignore.description: Ignore git-ignored files for buffer words.

coc.source.file.trimSameExts.description: Trim the same extension on file completion.

codeLens.enable.description: Enable the codeLens feature; requires Neovim with the virtual text feature.

codeLens.position.description: Display position of codeLens virtual text.

codeLens.separator.description: Separator text for codeLens in virtual text.

codeLens.subseparator.description: Subseparator between codeLenses in virtual text.

colors.enable.description: Enable the colors highlight feature. For terminal Vim, the 'termguicolors' option should be enabled and the terminal should support GUI colors.

colors.filetypes.deprecationMessage: Use colors.enable as language override configuration instead, see :h coc-configuration-scope
colors.filetypes.description: Filetypes that should be enabled for the colors highlight feature; use "*" for all filetypes.

colors.highlightPriority.description: Priority for colors highlights; works on Vim8 and Neovim >= 0.6.0.

cursors.cancelKey.description: Key used to cancel the cursors session.

cursors.nextKey.description: Key used to jump to the next cursors position.

cursors.previousKey.description: Key used to jump to the previous cursors position.

cursors.wrapscan.description: Search wraps around the first or last cursors range.

diagnostic.autoRefresh.description: Automatically refresh diagnostics; use the diagnosticRefresh action when disabled.

diagnostic.checkCurrentLine.description: When enabled, show all diagnostics of the current line if there are none at the current position.

diagnostic.displayByAle.description: Use Ale, coc-diagnostics-shim.nvim, or another provider to display diagnostics in Vim. This setting disables diagnostic display using coc's handler. A restart is required when changed.

diagnostic.displayByVimDiagnostic.description: Display diagnostics with nvim's `vim.diagnostic`. This setting disables diagnostic display using coc's handler. A restart is required when changed. Neovim only.

diagnostic.enable.description: Set to false to disable diagnostic display.

diagnostic.enableHighlightLineNumber.description: Enable highlighting line numbers for diagnostics; only works with Neovim.

diagnostic.enableMessage.description: When to show messages of diagnostics.

diagnostic.filetypeMap.description: A map between the buffer filetype and the filetype assigned to diagnostics. To syntax highlight diagnostics with their parent buffer type, use `"default": "bufferType"`.

diagnostic.floatConfig.description: Configure the float window style of diagnostic messages.

diagnostic.format.description: Define the diagnostic format shown in the float window or echoed. Available parts: source, code, severity, message.

diagnostic.highlightLimit.description: Limit the number of highlighted diagnostics; too many diagnostic highlights could make Vim stop responding.

diagnostic.highlightPriority.description: Priority for diagnostic highlights; works on Vim8 and Neovim >= 0.6.0.

diagnostic.level.description: Used for filtering diagnostics by severity.

diagnostic.locationlistLevel.description: Filter diagnostics in the location list.

diagnostic.locationlistUpdate.description: Update the location list on diagnostics change; only works with the location list opened by the :CocDiagnostics command and the first window of the associated buffer.

diagnostic.messageDelay.description: How long to wait (in milliseconds) before displaying the diagnostic message with echo or float.

diagnostic.messageLevel.description: Filter diagnostic messages in the float window/popup.

diagnostic.refreshOnInsertMode.description: Enable diagnostic refresh in insert mode. Default: false.

diagnostic.showDeprecated.description: Show diagnostics with the deprecated tag.

diagnostic.showUnused.description: Show diagnostics with the unused tag; affects highlight, sign, virtual text, and message.

diagnostic.signLevel.description: Filter diagnostics displayed in the sign column.

diagnostic.signPriority.description: Priority of diagnostic signs; defaults to 10.

diagnostic.virtualText.description: Use virtual text to display diagnostics.

diagnostic.virtualTextAlign.description: Position of the virtual text; defaults to 'after'.

diagnostic.virtualTextCurrentLineOnly.description: Only show virtual text diagnostics on the current cursor line.

diagnostic.virtualTextFormat.description: Define the virtual text diagnostic format. Available parts: source, code, severity, message.

diagnostic.virtualTextLevel.description: Filter diagnostic messages in virtual text by level.

diagnostic.virtualTextLimitInOneLine.description: Maximum number of diagnostic messages to display in one line.

diagnostic.virtualTextLineSeparator.description: The text that marks the end of a line in the diagnostic message.

diagnostic.virtualTextLines.description: The number of non-empty lines of a diagnostic to display.

diagnostic.virtualTextPrefix.description: The prefix added to virtual text diagnostics.

diagnostic.virtualTextWinCol.description: Window column number to align virtual text; Neovim only.

diagnostic.showRelatedInformation.description: Display related information in the diagnostic floating window.

dialog.confirmKey.description: Key used to confirm selection in menus and pickers; you can always use <esc> to cancel.

dialog.floatBorderHighlight.description: Highlight group for the border of dialog windows/popups; defaults to 'CocFloatBorder'.

dialog.floatHighlight.description: Highlight group for dialog windows/popups; defaults to 'CocFloating'.

dialog.maxHeight.description: Maximum height of the dialog window.

dialog.maxWidth.description: Maximum width of the dialog window.

dialog.pickerButtonShortcut.description: Show shortcuts in the buttons of the picker dialog window/popup; used when `dialog.pickerButtons` is true.

dialog.pickerButtons.description: Show buttons for the picker dialog window/popup.

dialog.rounded.description: Use a rounded border for dialog windows.

dialog.shortcutHighlight.description: Highlight group for the shortcut character in the menu dialog; defaults to 'MoreMsg'.

documentHighlight.priority.description: Match priority used by document highlight; see ':h matchadd'.

documentHighlight.limit.description: Limit the highlights added by matchaddpos; too many positions could make Vim slow.

documentHighlight.timeout.description: Timeout for document highlight, in milliseconds.

editor.autocmdTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the execute-request autocmd registered by coc extensions.

editor.fileOperationTimeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for the waitUntil handlers of file create, delete, and rename events.

editor.codeActionsOnSave.description: Run code actions for the buffer on save, normally source actions. Example: `"source.organizeImports": "always"`.

fileSystemWatch.watchmanPath.description: Executable path for https://facebook.github.io/watchman/; detected from $PATH by default.

fileSystemWatch.enable.description: Enable file system watch support for workspace folders.

fileSystemWatch.ignoredFolders.description: List of folders that should not be watched for file changes; environment variables and minimatch patterns can be used.

floatFactory.floatConfig.description: Configure the default float window/popup style created by the float factory (created around the cursor and automatically closed).

hover.autoHide.description: Automatically hide the hover float window on CursorMove or InsertEnter.

hover.floatConfig.description: Configure the float window style of hover documents.

hover.previewMaxHeight.description: Maximum height of the preview window for hover.

hover.target.description: Target used to show hover information; uses a floating window when possible by default.

http.proxy.description: The proxy setting to use. If not set, it's inherited from the `http_proxy` and `https_proxy` environment variables.

http.proxyAuthorization.description: The value to send as the `Proxy-Authorization` header for every network request.

http.proxyCA.description: CA (file) to use as the Certificate Authority.

http.proxyStrictSSL.description: Controls whether the proxy server certificate should be verified against the list of supplied CAs.

extensions.updateCheck.description: Interval for checking extension updates; can be daily, weekly, or never.

extensions.recommendations.description: List of extensions recommended for installation in the current project.

extensions.silentAutoupdate.description: Don't open a split window with update status when performing auto updates.

extensions.updateUIInTab.description: Display the extension update UI in a new Vim tab.

inlayHint.position.description: Controls where to show inlay hints: inline in the text, or at the end of the line

inlayHint.filetypes.description: Filetypes that enable inlay hints; all filetypes are enabled by default.
inlayHint.filetypes.deprecationMessage: Use inlayHint.enable with language scope instead, see :h coc-configuration-scope

inlayHint.refreshOnInsertMode.description: Refresh inlay hints in insert mode.

inlayHint.maximumLength.description: Maximum overall length of inlay hints on a single line before they are truncated by the editor. Set to `0` to disable truncation.

links.tooltip.description: Show tooltip of link under cursor on CursorHold.

links.highlight.description: Use the CocLink highlight group to highlight links.

list.floatPreview.description: Enable preview with a float window/popup. Default: `false`.

list.alignColumns.description: Whether to align lists in columns. Default: `false`.

list.extendedSearchMode.description: Enable extended search mode which allows multiple search patterns delimited by spaces.

list.height.description: Height of the split list window.

list.indicator.description: The character used as the first character in the prompt line.

list.interactiveDebounceTime.description: Debounce time for input changes in interactive mode.

list.limitLines.description: Limit lines for the list buffer.

list.maxPreviewHeight.description: Maximum height of the preview window of a list.

list.menuAction.description: Use a menu picker instead of confirm() for choosing an action.

list.nextKeymap.description: Key used to select the next line in insert mode.

list.previewHighlightGroup.description: Highlight group used to highlight the range in the preview window.

list.previewSplitRight.description: Use vsplit for the preview window.

list.previousKeymap.description: Key used to select the previous line in insert mode.

list.signOffset.description: Sign offset of the list; should be different from other plugins.

list.smartCase.description: Use smartcase matching for fuzzy and strict matching; `--ignore-case` is ignored, and this may not affect interactive lists.

list.source.diagnostics.includeCode.description: Whether to show the diagnostic code in the list.

list.source.diagnostics.pathFormat.description: Determines how the filepath is shown in the list.

list.source.outline.ctagsFiletypes.description: Filetypes that should use ctags for the outline instead of the language server.

list.source.symbols.excludes.description: Minimatch patterns for filepaths to exclude from the symbols list.

list.statusLineSegments.description: An array of statusline segments used to draw the status line for list windows.

notification.statusLineProgress.description: Show progress notifications in the status line instead of a float window/popup.

notification.border.description: Enable a rounded border for notification windows.

notification.disabledProgressSources.description: Sources for which message progress should be disabled; use * to disable all message-only progress.

notification.focusable.description: Enable focusing by user actions (wincmds, mouse events); Neovim only.

notification.highlightGroup.description: Highlight group of the notification dialog.

notification.marginRight.description: Margin to the right of the editor window.

notification.maxHeight.description: Maximum content height of the notification dialog.

notification.maxWidth.description: Maximum content width of the notification dialog.

notification.timeout.description: Timeout for auto-closing notifications, in milliseconds.

notification.winblend.description: Winblend option of the notification window; Neovim only.

npm.binPath.description: Command or absolute path to npm or yarn used for global extension install/uninstall.

outline.autoHide.description: Automatically close the outline window when an item is clicked.

outline.autoPreview.description: Enable auto preview on cursor move.

outline.autoWidth.description: Automatically increase window width to avoid wrapped lines.

outline.checkBufferSwitch.description: Recreate the outline view after the user switches to another buffer in the current tab.

outline.codeActionKinds.description: Filter code actions in the actions menu by kind.

outline.detailAsDescription.description: Show detail as a description next to the label; when false, the detail is shown in a tooltip on cursor hold.

outline.followCursor.description: Reveal the item in the outline tree on cursor hold.

outline.keepWindow.description: Jump back to the original window after the outline is shown.

outline.previewBorder.description: Use a border for the preview window.

outline.previewBorderHighlightGroup.description: Border highlight group of the preview window.

outline.previewBorderRounded.description: Use a rounded border for the preview window.

outline.previewHighlightGroup.description: Highlight group of the preview window.

outline.previewMaxWidth.description: Maximum width of the preview window.

outline.previewWinblend.description: Enable pseudo-transparency by setting the 'winblend' option of the window; Neovim only.

outline.showLineNumber.description: Show the line number of symbols.

outline.sortBy.description: Sort method for the symbols outline.

outline.splitCommand.description: Window split command used by the outline.

outline.switchSortKey.description: Key used to switch the sort method for the symbols provider of the current tree view.

outline.togglePreviewKey.description: Key used to toggle the auto preview feature.

pullDiagnostic.ignored.description: Minimatch patterns to match full filepaths that should be ignored for pullDiagnostic.

pullDiagnostic.onChange.description: Whether to pull for diagnostics on document change.

pullDiagnostic.onSave.description: Whether to pull for diagnostics on document save.

pullDiagnostic.workspace.description: Whether to pull for workspace diagnostics when possible.

refactor.afterContext.description: Print `num` lines of trailing context after each match.

refactor.beforeContext.description: Print `num` lines of leading context before each match.

refactor.openCommand.description: Open command for the refactor window.

refactor.saveToFile.description: Save the changed buffer to file when writing the refactor buffer with the ':noa wa' command.

refactor.showMenu.description: Refactor buffer local mapping to bring up a menu for the current chunk.

semanticTokens.combinedModifiers.description: Semantic token modifiers whose highlights should be combined with syntax highlights.

semanticTokens.filetypes.description: Filetypes that enable semantic tokens highlighting, or ["*"] for any filetype.
semanticTokens.filetypes.deprecationMessage: Use semanticTokens.enable configuration with language scope instead, see :h coc-configuration-scope

semanticTokens.incrementTypes.description: Semantic token types that should increase highlight when inserting at the start and end positions of a token.

signature.enable.description: Show signature help when a trigger character is typed.

signature.floatConfig.description: Configure the float window style of signature documents.

signature.hideOnTextChange.description: Hide the signature float window when text changes in insert mode.

signature.preferShownAbove.description: Show the signature help float window above the cursor when possible; requires restarting the service when changed.

signature.target.description: Target used to show signature help; uses float when possible by default.

signature.triggerSignatureWait.description: Timeout for triggering signature help, in milliseconds.

snippet.highlight.description: Use the 'CocSnippetVisual' highlight group to highlight placeholders with the same index as the current one.

snippet.nextPlaceholderOnDelete.description: Automatically jump to the next placeholder when the current one is completely deleted.

snippet.statusText.description: Text shown in the statusline to indicate that a snippet session is activated.

suggest.acceptSuggestionOnCommitCharacte.description: Controls whether suggestions should be accepted on commit characters. For example, in JavaScript, the semicolon (`;`) can be a commit character that accepts a suggestion and types that character.

suggest.asciiCharactersOnly.description: Trigger suggest with ASCII characters only.

suggest.segmenterLocales.description: Locales used to divide sentences into segments for the around and buffer sources; works when NodeJS is built with Intl support. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Intl/Segmenter/Segmenter#parameters. An empty string (the default) means auto-detect; use null to disable this feature.

suggest.asciiMatch.description: Convert Unicode characters to ASCII for matching.

suggest.completionItemKindLabels.description: Set custom labels for completion item kinds.

suggest.defaultSortMethod.description: Default sorting behavior for suggested completion items.

suggest.detailField.description: Where to show the detail text of the completion item from the language server.

suggest.detailMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the detail shown in the popup menu.

suggest.enableFloat.description: Enable a float window with documentation next to the popup menu.

suggest.enablePreselect.description: Enable the LSP preselect feature; works when `suggest.noselect` is false.

suggest.filterGraceful.description: Controls whether filtering and sorting suggestions accounts for small typos.

suggest.floatConfig.description: Configure the style of the popup menu and documentation window for completion.

suggest.formatItems.description: Items shown in the popup menu, in order.

suggest.highPrioritySourceLimit.description: Maximum number of items for sources with priority greater than or equal to 90.

suggest.insertMode.description: Controls whether words are overwritten when accepting completions. Use `insert` to only replace the typed prefix before the cursor and keep text after the cursor. Use `replace` to also replace matching text after the cursor.

suggest.ignoreRegexps.description: Regexps to ignore when triggering suggest.

suggest.invalidInsertCharacters.description: Invalid characters used to strip the valid word when inserting the text of a completion item.

suggest.labelMaxLength.description: Maximum length of the abbr shown as the label of a completion item.

suggest.localityBonus.description: Controls whether sorting favors words that appear close to the cursor.

suggest.lowPrioritySourceLimit.description: Maximum number of items for sources with priority lower than 90.

suggest.maxCompleteItemCount.description: Maximum number of completion items shown in Vim.

suggest.minTriggerInputLength.description: Minimum input length for triggering completion. Default: 1.

suggest.noselect.description: Don't make Vim select the first item when the popup menu is shown.

suggest.preferCompleteThanJumpPlaceholde.description: Confirm completion instead of jumping to the next placeholder when completion is activated.

suggest.pumFloatConfig.description: Configure the style of the popup menu; `suggest.floatConfig` is used when not specified.

suggest.removeDuplicateItems.description: Remove completion items with a duplicated word across all sources; snippet items are excluded.

suggest.removeCurrentWord.description: Remove the word item (from the around and buffer sources) that is identical to the current input.

suggest.reversePumAboveCursor.description: Reverse the order of completion items when the popup menu is shown above the cursor.

suggest.selection.description: Controls how suggestions are pre-selected when showing the suggest list.

suggest.snippetIndicator.description: The character used in the abbr of a completion item to indicate that the item can be expanded as a snippet.

suggest.snippetsSupport.description: Set to false to disable snippet support in completion.

suggest.triggerAfterInsertEnter.description: Trigger completion after InsertEnter; auto trigger should be 'always' to enable this option.

suggest.triggerCompletionWait.description: Wait time between text change and completion start; the completion is canceled when text changes during the wait.

suggest.virtualText.description: Show virtual text for the inserted word of the selected item, if any.

inlineSuggest.autoTrigger.description: Automatically trigger inline completion on cursor hold in insert mode.

inlineSuggest.triggerCompletionWait.description: Wait time in milliseconds between text change and triggering inline completion.

tree.closedIcon.description: Closed icon of the tree view.

tree.key.activeFilter.description: Trigger key to activate the filter.

tree.key.close.description: Trigger key to dispose the tree and close the tree window.

tree.key.collapseAll.description: Trigger key to collapse all tree nodes.

tree.key.invoke.description: Trigger key to invoke the default command of the current node or selection.

tree.key.selectNext.description: Trigger key to select the next item during filtering.

tree.key.selectPrevious.description: Trigger key to select the previous item during filtering.

tree.key.toggleSelection.description: Trigger key to select/unselect an item.

tree.openedIcon.description: Opened icon of the tree view.

typeHierarchy.enableTooltip.description: Enable a tooltip showing the relative filepath of a type hierarchy item.

typeHierarchy.openCommand.description: Open command for type hierarchy tree view.

typeHierarchy.splitCommand.description: Window split command used by type hierarchy tree view.

workspace.rootPatterns.description: Root patterns used to resolve the workspaceFolder from the parent folders of opened files, resolved from the top down.

workspace.ignoredFiletypes.description: Filetypes that should be ignored when resolving the workspace folder.

workspace.ignoredFolders.description: List of folders that should not be resolved as the workspace folder; environment variables and minimatch patterns can be used.

workspace.openOutputCommand.description: Command used to open the output channel.

workspace.openResourceCommand.description: Command used to open files that aren't loaded; files are loaded as hidden buffers when empty.
